summary: Frontend-only verification of the iteration-99 fixes with the PWA service worker ACTIVE (unregistered + all caches cleared once at start, then allowed to re-register and control the page for every mutation). PRIMARY FIX (SW runtimeCaching split) PASSES: on Organisation > Structure with the SW controlling the page, (a) create branch with manager -> branch AND 'Manager: Demo Manager' render without reload (4.0s), (b) rename branch -> new name renders, old name gone (4.6s), (c) create team -> renders (4.1s), (d) delete team (4.0s) and delete branch (4.6s) -> disappear immediately. Confirmed the deployed /sw.js contains registerRoute(/\/api\/org\/structure/, new NetworkOnly, 'GET') and that the runtime 'api-stable' cache only ever contains /admin/standards and /admin/standards/documents (no /org/structure entry). MINOR FIX (manager_user_id '' -> NULL) PASSES at DB level: POST with manager_user_id='' stores NULL, PUT assigning a manager stores the UUID, PUT with '' stores NULL again (verified with direct asyncpg reads on org_settings); tree drops the 'Manager:' line immediately in the UI. REGRESSIONS all pass: Standards Library loads in 3.0s with 47 CQC / 16 Care Cert / 10 users and no error banner (StaleWhileRevalidate rule still working), header reads '7 active staff members', PeopleHub Refresh renders 10 rows, Focus Topics add (3.5s) + delete instant with no reload. No console errors and no non-2xx API responses observed in any run.

minor.issue: Still ~2-3s per call from the public URL; every Structure mutation therefore takes ~4s (mutation + refetch) before the tree updates. Functionally correct but feels sluggish (carried over from iteration_98, unchanged).

ui_bugs.issue: STALE-FORM RACE (reproduced): during the ~4s refetch window after a mutation, the Edit buttons stay enabled and the modal prefills settingForm from the not-yet-refreshed structure. In my first run I renamed 'TEST99 Branch'->'TEST99 Renamed', re-opened Edit within 4s, changed only the Manager dropdown and saved — the PUT sent the STALE name and silently reverted the rename. Fix: optimistic local update after mutation (or disable edit/delete + show a spinner on the tree while refreshData() is in flight).
No visible loading indicator on the tree during the post-mutation refetch — the UI looks unchanged for ~4s after a successful save, which reads as 'nothing happened' to a user.
Native <input type="month"> browser picker still used for 'Assign to month' instead of the app's date-picker component (pre-existing, cosmetic).

ui_bugs.component: OrgSettings.js sub-tabs / Setting modal Manager select
ui_bugs.issue: Testability gap: the Settings page sub-tabs (Supervision Template / Export All / Transcripts / Branding / Focus Topics / Security) and the Manager <select> inside the Add/Edit Setting modal have no data-testid, forcing text/structural selectors in automation.

design_issues.screen: Organisation > Structure / Settings > Focus Topics / Standards Library
issues: No contrast, spacing or alignment defects found at 1920x1080; footer and header render correctly on all three screens.

action_items: MEDIUM: guard the Structure tab against the stale-form race — after a mutation either apply an optimistic local update or disable the edit/delete controls (with a spinner) until refreshData() resolves, so a user re-opening Edit during the ~4s refetch cannot PUT stale field values and revert their own change.
LOW: add a refreshing indicator on [data-testid="org-tree"] during the post-mutation refetch.
LOW: add data-testid to the Settings page sub-tabs and to the Manager select in the Add/Edit Setting modal.
LOW (pre-existing): replace the native month input in FocusTopicsTab with the app's date-picker component.
critical_code_review_comments: vite.config.mjs runtimeCaching is now correct: /api/org/structure is its own NetworkOnly rule and /api/admin/standards is the only StaleWhileRevalidate entry; verified against the deployed build (public /sw.js) and at runtime via caches.open('api-stable') keys.

org.py create_setting/update_setting mgr_id = data.manager_user_id or None is correct and verified against Postgres (NULL, not ''). Consider moving the coercion into the SettingCreate Pydantic model (validator) so every future consumer of the model benefits; the same '' vs NULL risk exists for team supervisor_user_id in create_team/update_team — worth a spot-check.

OrgStructure.saveSetting sends the whole settingForm on PUT (name + description + manager) rather than only the changed field, which is what makes the stale-prefill race destructive; a PATCH-style partial update would remove the hazard entirely.

success_rate.backend: 100% (API/DB spot checks: create/rename/clear-manager/delete all 200 and immediately consistent; manager_user_id NULL verified)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested scenarios pass (4/4 SW mutation cases, manager->None, standards regression, 3/3 iter98 smoke checks)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The SW caching bug is FIXED and verified with the SW active; do not re-test it. Method that works: goto '/', evaluate unregister-all-SW + caches.delete once, add cookies, goto /organisation, wait 4s, reload, wait 4s -> navigator.serviceWorker.controller is non-null; then poll [data-testid="org-tree"] inner_text for up to 25-30s after each mutation. CRITICAL: do NOT assert at a fixed 4s — GET /api/org/structure alone takes 2-3s so a mutation needs 4-5s to show; short waits produce false 'stale' failures AND can trigger the stale-form race described in ui_bugs (my first run accidentally reverted a rename that way). Focus Topics live on /settings > 'Focus Topics' sub-tab (not Organisation > Settings). Writing files under /app/backend triggers a uvicorn reload (~25s of 502s) — sleep before hitting the API.
rca_of_the_issue: iteration_98's root cause (workbox StaleWhileRevalidate on /api/org/structure serving pre-mutation payloads) is resolved: the built sw.js now registers /api/org/structure as NetworkOnly and the runtime api-stable cache contains only /admin/standards entries, so every post-mutation GET hits the network (backend also sends Cache-Control: no-store, so the HTTP cache cannot re-introduce staleness). Remaining perceived staleness is purely latency (~4s: mutation RTT + 2-3s structure refetch) plus the absence of an optimistic update / in-flight lock, which additionally exposes a destructive stale-prefill race in the Edit Setting modal. The manager_user_id hygiene fix is confirmed at the database level (NULL on create-with-empty and on clear-manager update).
